# Kolte-Patil Life Republic Hinjewadi

> 390-Acre Integrated Sustainable Township in Hinjewadi-Marunji, Pune West. MahaRERA registered.

Kolte-Patil Life Republic is an integrated gated township developed by Kolte-Patil Developers Ltd. (NSE: KOLTEPATIL) situated along the 150-ft Spine Road in Marunji, Hinjewadi, Pune. Spread across 390 contiguous acres, the township features over 20,000 residents, the operational Crimson Anisha Global School, a 3.5-acre central urban park, sports stadiums, high-street retail, and 15 distinct residential sectors.

## Active Residential Clusters & Properties

- [Kolte Patil Canvas (Sector R5)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-canvas-luxury-3-4-bhk-flats-hinjewadi): Luxury 3, 3.5 & 4 BHK residences across four 40-storey architectural towers. MahaRERA: P52100077008.
- [Kolte Patil Duet (Sector R34)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-duet-premium-2-bhk-flats-hinjewadi): Smart, space-efficient 2 BHK apartments in Eterna and Infinite high-rise towers. MahaRERA: P52100079424.
- [Kolte Patil Echoes (Sector R31)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-echoes-new-launch-2-2-5-bhk-hinjewadi): Hafeez Contractor designed 2 & 2.5 BHK eco-chic residences. MahaRERA: PM1261012502409.
- [Kolte Patil 24K Espada (Sector R31)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-24k-espada-ultra-luxury-row-houses-hinjewadi): Signature 4 & 5 BHK ultra-luxury row houses with private elevator shafts and terraces. MahaRERA: P52100002646.
- [Kolte Patil Atmos (Sector R22)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-atmos-modern-2-3-bhk-flats-hinjewadi): Modern 2, 2.5 & 3 BHK high-rise residences with sky amenities and sunset views. MahaRERA: P52100051765.
- [Kolte Patil Aros (Sector R13)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-aros-premium-2-3-bhk-flats-hinjewadi): Premium 2 & 3 BHK residences situated directly facing the 3.5-acre Central Urban Park. MahaRERA: P52100047921.
- [Kolte Patil Qrious (Sector R14)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-qrious-smart-2-3-bhk-homes-hinjewadi): Tech-enabled 2 & 3 BHK smart homes on the 150-ft Spine Road with 90+ retail units. MahaRERA: P52100079623.
- [Kolte Patil The Universe (Sector R10)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-universe-luxury-1-2-bhk-flats-hinjewadi): Smart 1 & 2 BHK homes in collaboration with Planet Smart City. MahaRERA: P52100027629.
- [Kolte Patil Nora (Sector R17B)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-villas-hinjewadi): Exclusive custom bungalow plots with full civic infrastructure ready for construction. MahaRERA: P52100022278.
- [Kolte Patil Sound of Soul (Sector R17A)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-sound-of-soul-luxury-4-bhk-row-houses-hinjewadi): Serene 4 BHK triplex row houses surrounded by lush landscape buffers. MahaRERA: P52100079424.
- [Kolte Patil Arezo (Sector R16)](https://life-republic.in/projects/kolte-patil-life-republic-arezo-efficient-2-bhk-flats-hinjewadi): Ready-to-move and near-possession 2 BHK residences. MahaRERA: P52100018539.

## Township Guides & Infrastructure

- [Township Master Guide](https://life-republic.in/township-guide): Complete guide covering 390 acres of spatial engineering, sector distributions, and civic zoning.
- [Amenities & Lifestyle](https://life-republic.in/amenities): Crimson Club, Olympic-length swimming pool, sports academies, and central park features.
- [Location & Connectivity](https://life-republic.in/location): Transit times to Hinjewadi Phase 1 IT Park (4.5 km), upcoming Metro Line 3, and Mumbai-Pune Expressway.
- [NRI Investment Desk](https://life-republic.in/nri-corner): Specialized services for overseas Indian buyers, foreign currency rates, FEMA tax compliance, and rental yield portfolios.
- [Township Intelligence Dashboard](https://life-republic.in/township-intelligence): Real-time updates on township infrastructure development, traffic management, and civic sustainability.
